attribution: Data compiled by Doug White / researchvessels.org
note: DRAFT prototype of non-ship platforms (University of Delaware Robotic Discovery Laboratories). Compiled from public sources only, with no UD confirmation. Corrections welcome at ships@oceandata.org. platform_id values are researchvessels.org slugs, not sourced identifiers.
